rationale: The assistant firmly and correctly refused the DIY regas up front, flagged flammable refrigerant and 'don't pierce or cut any pipes', then asked the single most discriminating check (frost on the evaporator) and used the 'no frost anywhere' answer to conclude a sealed-system fault and refer to a certified engineer. It never asked about the refrigerant type, oily marks, knife-defrosting history or the appliance's age, so it missed the chance to tell a cost-conscious owner of a 9-year-old Indesit that repair is probably uneconomic and replacement may be the sensible route. Speculation about 'blocked filter drier or a failed valve plate' is unsupported but hedged as examples rather than a diagnosis, and no parts were pushed.
